paper.title_en: Evading Cauchy Horizon Excision in Scalarized Regular Black Holes
paper.abstract_en: Spontaneous scalarization provides a dynamical mechanism to evade the no-hair paradigm, but it has been argued to generically eliminate the Cauchy horizon in charged black holes. We show that this obstruction is not universal, but instead follows from the sign-definite structure of the Einstein-Maxwell source term. Within the $P$-dual formulation of nonlinear electrodynamics, we derive a general condition under which the effective scalar source changes sign between the horizons, allowing the integral constraint to be satisfied without destroying the Cauchy horizon. This establishes that the fate of the Cauchy horizon depends on the electromagnetic coupling and identifies candidate theories where scalarized horizons may persist. The resulting framework opens the possibility of studying scalarization in the inter-horizon region and its interplay with mass inflation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究了标量化与柯西视界的关系，提出了新的理论条件，属于广义相对论基础领域，具有理论深度和潜在影响。
decision.title_zh: 规避标量化规则黑洞中的柯西视界切除
decision.abstract_zh: 自发标量化为规避无毛范式提供了一种动力学机制，但有人提出，在带电荷黑洞中，它通常会消除柯西视界。我们证明，这种阻碍并非普遍存在，而是源于爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦源项的正负定结构。在非线性电动力学的P-对偶表述中，我们推导出一个一般条件，在该条件下，有效标量源在两个视界之间改变符号，从而使得积分约束得到满足而不破坏柯西视界。这确立了柯西视界的命运取决于电磁耦合，并确定了标量化视界可能持续存在的候选理论。由此产生的框架为研究视界间区域中的标量化及其与质量膨胀的相互作用提供了可能性。
